code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    background = max((v for v in colors if v != 0), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    marker = next(v for v in colors if v not in (0, background))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
    sh, sw = max(r for r, c in shape)+1, max(c for r, c in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(h-sh+1):
        for left in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[top+dr][left+dc] in (0, marker) for dr, dc in shape):
                if any(grid[top+dr][left+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                    for dr, dc in shape:
                        out[top+dr][left+dc] = marker
    return out
'''
